title: Isolation of Bone Marrow-Derived Macrophages from Mice
author: Not specified
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gcqbsvw

steps.title: Prepare Culture Plate
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of media per well in a 6-well plate, allocating one well per animal or per two marrows.

steps.title: Prepare Femur for Marrow Extraction
steps.instruction: Clean the femur in a petri dish using a small amount of PBS or phenol red-free media, focusing on the middle section, then cut off both ends of the femur to expose the marrow.

steps.title: Flush Bone Marrow
steps.instruction: Extract the marrow by flushing it into the 6-well plate using a syringe filled with 2 mL of media until the bone turns from pink to white.

substeps.instruction: Pass the media through the syringe 1-2 times, starting with a 20G needle and then a 26G needle.

steps.title: Perform RBC Lysis
steps.instruction: Isolate cells from red blood cells using RBC lysis solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to a 50 mL tube.
Prepare RBC lysis solution (per cabinet proportions) or use Sigma commercial solution.
Add 5 mL of lysis solution per marrow.
Place on ice for exactly 10 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4°C and 400g (~RCF or 1200 rpm).

steps.title: Resuspend and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Immediately resuspend the cell pellet to prevent drying and transfer to a culture dish.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL CSF and 12 mL RPMI Medium (total 15 mL), or alternatively 3 mL CSF and 9 mL RPMI medium.
Transfer the 15 mL cell suspension to a 100 mm polystyrene tissue culture petri dish (Primaria™, Becton Dickinson Labware) for 24 hours.

steps.title: Expand Macrophage Culture
steps.instruction: Culture non-adherent cells for 6 days to differentiate them.

substeps.instruction: After 24 hours, transfer non-adherent cells to fresh polystyrene petri dishes or non-adherent flasks (Green - Fisher).
Grow cultures for 6 days using 15% (v/v) L-929 cell-conditioned medium as an M-CSF source (approx 3 mL of 15 mL). Note: If using the Kyoko/Rabi batch at 30%, use 5 mL.

steps.title: Collect and Process Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells and remove aggregates.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells after 6 days using a cell scraper (policeman 25 cm, Sarstedt #83,1830).
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 400 x g.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of RPMI 10% FBS (without Pen/Strep, Phenol free for LDH).
Flush media through 25, 27, and 30 G needles to separate aggregates.

steps.title: Count and Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Quantify cells and seed them into plates for infection.

substeps.instruction: Dilute cells 1/5 in Turks solution to count.
Adjust to a final concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Aliquot 500 µL (5x10^5 cells) per well in a 24-well plate, or 100 µL for a 96-well plate.

steps.title: Final Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates overnight at 5% CO2 before proceeding to infection.
